title: Teodoro dares Trillanes: Submit proof of alleged Duterte China funds

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Defense Secretary Gilbert “Gibo” Teodoro Jr. on Saturday said former Sen. Antonio Trillanes IV should submit evidence to law enforcement authorities of his allegations that Chinese funds went to an organization linked to Vice President Sara Duterte and her family. “The allegations of former Senator Trillanes, if substantiated, raise serious implications for national security,” Teodoro said in a message forwarded to reporters by Palace press officer Claire Castro. “He should submit the evidence in his possession, if any, to our law enforcement authorities so the matter can be thoroughly investigated,” he added.
